branchAccess.title: No admin access
branchAccess.roleCannotOpen: Your {role} account can’t open the back office for {branch}. Your work is on the counter or kitchen screen.
branchAccess.accountCannotOpen: Your account can’t open the back office for {branch}. Your work is on the counter or kitchen screen.
branchAccess.notStaff: Your account isn’t a member of staff at {branch}.

noAccess.title: You’re a driver here
noAccess.body: Driver accounts don’t use the restaurant back office. Open the Favornoms Driver app to see the jobs assigned to you, your delivery history and your earnings.
noAccess.askOwner: If you should also have back-office access, ask the restaurant owner to invite you again with a manager or admin role.

platformBanner.title: Platform admin view
platformBanner.body: You are not staff of {branch}. Every change you make here is recorded against your account.

suspension.title: Subscription inactive

locked.counter: The counter is locked for {branch} because the subscription has lapsed.
locked.screen: This screen is locked for {branch} because the subscription has lapsed.

lockedHere.counter: The counter is locked for this branch because the subscription has lapsed.
lockedHere.screen: This screen is locked for this branch because the subscription has lapsed.

suspension.nothingDeleted: No data has been deleted — choosing a package restores everything immediately.
suspension.kitchenStillWorks: Orders already placed can still be cooked and completed from the kitchen display.

lockedFeature.notInPackage: {feature} is part of the {addon} add-on and is not included in your current package.

upload.noCanvas: Your browser could not process the image (no canvas support).

notice.darkLogo: This logo is dark and will be hard to see for customers using dark mode. Undo, or upload a light version.
notice.lightLogo: This logo is light and will be hard to see on the light storefront. Undo, or upload a darker version.

errors.formatUnsupported: This image format cannot be processed here. Upload the logo as a PNG or JPEG.
errors.svgUnreadable: Could not read this SVG. Remove the background inside the SVG file, or upload a PNG.
errors.noPlainBackground: There is no plain background around this image to remove.

iconUpload.requirements: Square PNG, JPEG or WebP, at least 192×192. A PNG with a transparent background gives you the most choice. We resize it into every size the browser and the installed app need.

removeBackground.label: Remove the plain background around the image
removeBackground.hint: The white (or other flat colour) outside your logo becomes the colour you pick below — no white corners on any icon.

transparent.label: Only the image, no background (like a PNG)
transparent.hint: For the browser tab and installing on a computer. Phones cannot show transparency — Android and iPhone always put a solid colour behind the image, so pick that colour below.

iconUpload.zoomHint: Zoom in to make the artwork bigger on Android.

colour.hintFromEdge: The first colours come from the edge of your image — picking the rim colour makes the tile look seamless.
colour.hintFrameOnly: Only the frame around your icon changes colour; the icon keeps the background it was made with.
colour.tickRemoveFirst: Tick “Remove the plain background” to choose a colour for the area around your image.
colour.backgroundBakedIn: This icon’s background is part of the image. To choose a different colour, upload your original again — ideally a PNG with a transparent background.

preview.hint: Roughly what each device shows. Android crops to its own shape and iPhone rounds the corners — both need a solid colour, and zoom only applies to Android. Computers and browser tabs can show just your image.

iconUpload.repaintsRemoved: The background colour is the same as the one being removed — pick another colour, or the corners will look unchanged.
iconUpload.oldPadding: Your current icon still has the old white padding — apply, then save.

errors.loadFailed: Could not load your current icon. Upload it again to change its style.
errors.encodeFailed: Could not encode the resized icon.
errors.wrongType: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image. SVG cannot be used as an app icon.
errors.tooLarge: That image is larger than {megabytes} MB.
errors.tooSmall: That image is {width}×{height}. App icons need at least {min}×{min} — a smaller one makes the install button disappear.
